name: docsmith
description: Author polished, print-ready PDFs from a source document by composing hand-written JSX with the @docsmith/builder component library — styled to vanilla ShadCN tokens (light/dark), rendered via @react-pdf/renderer, with mermaid diagrams as real vector cards and nothing running off the page. Ships the docsmith:builder skill. Use when making a designed/branded PDF, exporting a README or doc to PDF, or rendering a doc whose mermaid diagrams must appear as real diagrams.
